retrievalProfile.description: A gritty 90s urban aesthetic featuring a tilted photographic frame overlaid on a chain-link fence background with heavy, shadowed slab-serif typography.
triggerTerms: heavy slab serif with red drop shadow

recipe.visualDefinition: A layered composition consisting of a blurred, purple-tinted chain-link fence background, a central tilted rectangular photo frame containing a group of figures in an urban setting, and bold, heavy-weight typography with high-contrast drop shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Tilted central frame against a static background
Heavy black text with vibrant red offset shadows
Cool-toned background contrasting with warm-toned photo highlights
Foreground typography overlapping the central image frame
coreInvariants: Chain-link fence texture in the background
Heavy slab-serif display type with hard-edged drop shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of figures occupies a central rectangular frame, tilted approximately 10 degrees counter-clockwise.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold display text at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top display text, move down through the tilted photo, and finish at the bottom horizontal text bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The outer margins are filled with a blurred, purple-hued chain-link fence pattern.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted purple and blue tones in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for primary letterforms and frame borders.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for typographic drop shadows and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between black text and light background; high saturation in the red accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with heavy block terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales and colors to maintain urban grit.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure and blunt terminals.
Provides the necessary geometric slab-serif weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a blurred, purple-tinted background of a chain-link fence. Place a black-bordered rectangular photo frame in the center, tilted 10 degrees counter-clockwise, containing a gritty urban group portrait.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy slab-serif text in black with a bright red hard-edged drop shadow. Position the main title at the top left and a secondary title at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a distinct red drop shadow?
Is the background a chain-link fence texture?
Is the font a heavy slab-serif?

adjustableVariables: Tilt angle of the central frame
Density of the chain-link fence pattern
mustRedesign: Brand logos or specific artist names

mustAchieve: Layered depth through shadows and frames

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red shadow is offset and hard-edged.
Verify the chain-link fence is visible but not distracting.
Check that the tilted frame does not cut off essential text.
Confirm the slab-serif weight is sufficiently 'black' or 'extra bold'.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Collage = (Tilted Photo Frame + Chain Link Background) * (Heavy Slab Serif + Red Drop Shadow)
